component.name: Seeker
component.summary: Find files by name and by the text inside them

description.p: Seeker is a fast desktop search tool for your files. Type a file-name pattern, optionally some text to look for inside the files, pick one or more folders, and results stream in while the search runs.

ul.li: File-name wildcards such as *.rs;*.txt with exclusions, or regular expressions
Search inside files for plain text or regular expressions, with match case and whole-word options
Several start folders at once, with folders to skip and optional .gitignore support
Filters for hidden files, symbolic links, binary files, file size and modification date
Parallel search on all CPU cores that can be stopped at any time
Sortable results with a preview of every matching line, highlighted, with context lines
Open files and their folders straight from the results, or export them as CSV or text
Handles unreadable folders, non-UTF-8 text and very large files gracefully

description.p: Seeker uses the same search libraries as the ripgrep command-line tool.

screenshot.caption: Searching source files for text, with highlighted matches in the preview
Opening a result or its folder from the context menu
Finding large files by name, size and date

ul.li: Opening files and folders works inside sandboxes through the desktop portal
Desktop file and icon renamed to the application id
